name: Iterative Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE) Solver for Light Diffusion
definition: A method to visualize structures and regions of interest in volumes without global segmentation by solving the Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE) iteratively to simulate fluid-like light diffusion based on light transport.
summary: This method approximates light transport in participating media by reducing the Radiance Transfer Equation to a diffusion equation, enabling efficient, view-independent per-voxel computation without storing full light paths.
